why_preregistered: DECISION_RULES 6 allows OVERALL=PASS only if the gates actually pass. A gate chosen after seeing the numbers is not a gate, so the rule, the candidate set and the tie-breaks are fixed here before any extension iteration executes.
candidate_set: every intermediate checkpoint written during the extension, plus the two pre-extension finals. Recency confers no advantage and is not a tie-break.

selection_rule.primary: EXTERNAL PANEL win rate against the four frozen scripted opponents (dragapult, mega_lucario, iono, mega_abomasnow), balanced seats, identical game count per candidate.
selection_rule.secondary: MCGS transfer-prior utility: field score of the T1 arm using that checkpoint as the expansion prior.
explicitly_excluded: internal self-play win rate -- DECISION_RULES 4 forbids selecting a checkpoint on self-play alone
checkpoint recency -- the last checkpoint is not privileged
training-set win rate from the learning curve itself, which is measured on the same games that produced the gradient
selection_rule.tie_break: fewer training games (prefer the earlier checkpoint at equal measured strength, since it is the less overfit one)

early_stop_conditions: clear instability: actor_error_rate > 0.01, or loss/grad_norm non-finite
collapse: entropy falls below 0.25 of its value at extension start
sustained external regression: external-panel win rate below the pre-extension baseline for 3 consecutive checkpoint evaluations

gates_for_OVERALL_PASS.external: a selected checkpoint must beat the pre-extension baseline on the external panel by more than the measured reproducibility bound
gates_for_OVERALL_PASS.transfer: a transfer arm's 95% Wilson lower bound must exceed the T0 control's upper bound, per DECISION_RULES 3
gates_for_OVERALL_PASS.note: BOTH are required. Neither is satisfied by an improvement measured only against the agent's own history.
